# Contributor License Agreement (CLA)

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Infisical!

To ensure that the open-source community and users of Infisical can rely on contributions without legal uncertainty, we require contributors to complete a Contributor License Agreement (CLA).

---

## Individual CLA

If you are contributing code as an individual, you can complete the CLA agreement digitally when opening your pull request.

1. Submit your pull request to the [Infisical repository](https://github.com/Infisical/infisical).
2. The CLA bot will check if you have signed the CLA. If not, follow the link provided in the PR comment or visit [https://cla.infisical.com/sign](https://cla.infisical.com/sign).
3. Sign in with your GitHub account and accept the agreement.
4. Once accepted, the CLA status check on your pull request will update automatically.

---

## Corporate Contributor License Agreement (CCLA)

If you are contributing as part of your employment or on behalf of your company or organization, your employer must execute a Corporate Contributor License Agreement (CCLA).

The CCLA covers contributions made by authorized employees and lists their GitHub handles in Schedule A (or an associated roster) so pull requests pass automated CLA checks.

### How to Execute a Corporate CLA

1. **Request the Corporate CLA**: Contact the Infisical team at [contribute@infisical.com](mailto:contribute@infisical.com) (or [security@infisical.com](mailto:security@infisical.com)) with the subject line `Corporate CLA Request - <Company Name>`.
2. **Review and Sign Schedule A**: Infisical will provide the CCLA document and Schedule A. An authorized representative of your organization signs the agreement and provides the list of authorized employee names, corporate email addresses, and GitHub handles.
3. **Allowlisting GitHub Handles**: Upon receiving the countersigned CCLA, the Infisical team allowlists the specified GitHub handles in the CLA verification system.
4. **Submitting Pull Requests**: Pull requests opened by allowlisted GitHub handles will automatically pass the CLA verification check.

To add or update authorized contributors under an existing CCLA, an authorized company representative can email [contribute@infisical.com](mailto:contribute@infisical.com) with the updated list of GitHub handles.
